newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thailand's Sinn Bualuang Co sets US$100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Sinn Bualuang Co sets US$100 mln loan.

text.p: Sinn Bualuang Co has launched a US$100 million transferable loan certificates facility, the arrangers said on Tuesday.
The loan has a final maturity of five years from the date of drawdown, subject to annual put options.
The facility pays a margin of 75 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.

Fees are 42.5 basis points for co-lead managers commiting to US$8 million and above for an all-in return of 117.5 basis points, 40 basis points for senior managers commiting to US$4 million to US$7.9 million for an all-in return of 115 basis points and 35 basis points for managers commiting to US$4 million and below for an all-in return of 110 basis points.
There is a put waiver fee of 35 basis points.
Governing law is English and force majeure applies.
Sinn Bualuang was founded in 1986 by Bangkok Bank as a holding company to carry out non-bank financial activities of the bank.

The loan agreement includes a covenant mandating that certain shareholders must maintain at least 55 percent of the borrower's issued capital. They are Chatri Sophon Co and the Sophon Panich family, Bangkok Bank, Asia Credit Public Co, Union Asia Finance, Bangkok Insurance, P Capital Co and the Pilun-owad family, and Asia Sermkij Co.
The agreement also stipulates that the company's total debt to equity ratio must not exceed 10:1.
Arrangers of the facility are Hua Nan Commercial Bank, KEXIM Asia, London Forfaiting Asia Pacific, Shinhan Finance and UMBC International Bank (L) Ltd.
London Forfaiting Asia Ltd, Cyprus is the facility agent.
Sinn Bualuang Co completed a similar five-year transferable loan certificates facility in March with the amount increased to US$150 million from original US$120 million.
